set.StepText: Kill cervideth (ghostly giant elks) outside the Grove of Aalid Feie and bring Sarah the Cervideth Antlers.
set.SourceText: Kill cervideth (ghostly giant elks) outside the Grove of Aalid Feie and bring Sarah the Cervideth Antlers.

entries.source: Allakhazam quest Cervideth Antlers -- Kill Task (551): Start NPC Sarah, "Sarah in the Grove of Aalid Feie wants skeletal elk antlers"
entries.why: the kill task was given by the merchant Miniine and the journal showed the generator note "Giver not recorded..."; the period giver Sarah stands in the Grove of Aalid Feie (Vale of Balor 49645,25611)
the antlers are handed to Sarah (trade target and marker moved from Miniine); the drop is unchanged
MinLevel and MaxLevel were both 11, so a Berserker who reached 12 first could never get Rasczel's Bane; Prima's "11" is the start level and the other guild quests use MaxLevel 50

set.StepText: Return to Sir Verin at Swanton Keep.|Return to Magess Islia in Merlin's Tower.|Return to Lady Nimue.|Speak with Lady Nimue again to receive your reward. Afterwards Loremaster Alain at the Academy in Camelot asks you to return at level 30.

entries.source: Allakhazam quest Legend of the Lake (level 25) (186): "Return to Lady Nimue to receive a Master of Arms Platemail Breastplate or Scout reward ... After 25, you have to visit Loremaster Alain at the Academy in Camelot - he tells you to come back when you are lvl 30"
entries.why: the level 25 reward was handed out by Loremaster Alain; in the period Lady Nimue gives it and Alain only says to come back at 30. The finishing step (step 4) now targets Lady Nimue (kept as a fourth step so a player already on it is not stuck)
the reward step now points at Lady Nimue; the same spot part09 (P09-B4) gives her step-3 marker, her period night spot in the Avalon Marsh lake
